items.title: How much does check-in frequency bound how late you can find out?
items.description: In the worst case, a struggling person's signals start right after a check-in — so the next check-in is the earliest point they could realistically be caught, if nothing was noticed in between. Drag the time between check-ins and watch the worst-case detection delay move with it. At 21 days (about 3 weeks), this reproduces Report B's actual timeline from L3.

outputs.label: Worst-case days before a quiet struggle could be caught
